scripts.deploy:development: npm run minikube:start && echo $(ksync init) && npm run minikube:dns && npm run minikube:deploy && sudo echo && (minikube tunnel >/dev/null &)
scripts.api:certs: cd api && kubectl cp default/$(kubectl get pods -l app=development-c-lightning-rest -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}' --all-namespaces):/usr/src/app/certs ./certs
scripts.api:development: npm run api:certs && cd api && npm run start:dev -- -- --selfUrl=http://localhost:3000
scripts.api:logs: (ksync watch &) && sleep 5 && ksync delete --all && ksync create --selector=app=development-api $(pwd)/api/src /usr/src/app/api/src && kubectl logs --follow --selector=app=development-api
scripts.minikube:dns: minikube addons enable ingress && minikube addons enable ingress-dns && npx ts-node ops/infrastructure/minikube/minikube-dns.ts
scripts.minikube:deploy: npm run minikube:loadApi && minikube kubectl -- apply -f ops/infrastructure/minikube/minikube.yaml --validate=false
scripts.minikube:loadApi: (docker image inspect api:latest >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo no || docker build --target development -t api:latest -f api/Dockerfile .) && minikube image load --overwrite=false api:latest
